Introduction
This 
document lists steps for testing magnetisation curve test for current 
transformer and measuring magnetising current following for different values of 
applied equipment inspection check list I1 which are done frequently
The 
first draft initiated by eng. Sabry Shabaan Abd el-Latif, and tested by Hani 
Bassuoni and eng. Sherif Mahrous accepted by technical expert eng. Hassan 
elbehiry and approved by eng. Fathy El sayed head sector of El-kureimat power 
station and general manager of inspection and quality control sector eng. Gamal 
Abd El wahab
Safety Precautions
A work order must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area
Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes
Transformer isolation and proper earthing is required

Work to be Carried Out
Connect ammeter to the secondary of current transformer see fig (1)
Connect voltammeter to the secondary of current transformer see fig (1)
Connect sverker 650 to the secondary of current transformer
Test is conducted only up to knee point which is at a point where 10% 
 increase in applied voltage results in 50% increase in magnetizing current
